title: Omarchy Zones
subtitle: Floating workspace settings
padding_help: The same space around all four sides and between zones. Shared gaps are never doubled.
saved: Changes save automatically. Applies to your next snap.
monitor_help: Choose a layout for Floating workspaces on this monitor. Workspace overrides take priority.
workspace_help: Override the layout for this Floating workspace on this monitor.
overlap_help: Overlapping zones are allowed. The closest zone center under your pointer wins; occupied zones can still be used. Drag to an edge for half or full width.
workspace_override: This workspace has its own layout. Select the Workspace tab to adjust it.
